headline: California Labor Market Stagnates Despite Strong AI Sector Expansion
summary: A California State University Fullerton economic study found the state's economy is being bolstered by artificial intelligence investments, but broader employment remains mired in a low-hire, low-fire stasis.
why: California is the fifth-largest economy in the world; tech-led capital investment diverging from broader employment metrics reveals uneven regional productivity growth.

impacts.name: US Technology
impacts.why: Continued capital flows into AI ventures bolster technology industry output and regional gross product.
